mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned Omai Property, central Guyana (~165 km south of Georgetown; past-producing mine). Updated PEA Aug 19, 2026: combined Wenot open pit + Gilt underground; 25,000 tpd plant at 93% recovery; 18-yr LOM; 6.327 Moz payable gold; avg 351,488 oz/yr; peak 435,667 oz/yr. Base case (US$3,600/oz Au): after-tax NPV5% US$4.0B (C$5.5B), IRR 24%, payback 4.1 yrs; spot (US$4,200/oz): NPV5% US$5.5B, IRR 30%, payback 3.4 yrs. Initial capex US$1.427B; sustaining+growth capex US$928M; LOM capex US$2.396B; LOM cumulative after-tax FCF US$8.094B; cash costs US$1,501/oz; AISC US$1,608/oz; avg strip ratio 5.9:1. No reserves declared (PEA-stage). Resource update expected year-end 2026; feasibility study targeted 2027. No production.

notes: Developer; no FY2025 production or revenue. TSX-V:OMG, OTCQB:OMGGF. President & CEO Elaine Ellingham. Strategic shareholders include Silvercorp Metals and Sandstorm Gold. The Aug 2026 updated PEA supersedes the April 2024 Wenot-only PEA (after-tax NPV5% US$556M, IRR 19.8% @ US$1,950/oz Au; 142 koz/yr over 13 yrs; capex US$375M). All economics in USD.
